tips.text: Always collect the 3 Sister Beacons to summon the Sister; she is a big share of each run's Motes.
Run Ascension on Steel Path for more Motes per run; the Eximus-packed mission also pays out affinity.
Switch to Operator or Drifter and void sling up the elevator shaft to spot the blue and white beacon glow; Titania flying upward also works.
Skip beacons that are awkward to reach; more than three spawn.
Turn every audio channel down except sound effects so the beacon chime is easy to hear.
Skip drop boosters and loot abilities like Desecrate here; they do not affect part drops or Motes.
Solo the normal node or use recruiting chat; public matchmaking is often empty.
Shoot the orb atop a Jade Light Eximus beam or kill the Eximus; the beam can kill your Warframe even in Operator form.
Bring Banshee's Silence to shut down the Light Eximus, or Gloom to slow even the Sister.
Expect a full set in about 10 to 25 runs; the Mote shop means bad luck cannot drag it out.
